instruction.text: Informational texts like this one can be difficult to understand. Let’s learn about a helpful strategy. Select the title of the text to hear about it.

end.text: Informational texts often describe a process with several steps. If you break the text up into each step, it can make it easier to understand. Let’s take a closer look at our example.

atoms.text: At first, a frog’s life starts as an egg.
atoms.sound: Watching a Frog’s Life Cycle. At first, a frog’s life starts as an egg.

atoms.text: Then the eggs develop into tadpoles.
After having developed their bodies in the changing stage, the frog gains its adult body at last.

instruction.text: Can you put the steps of a frog’s life in the correct order? The text above can help you.

text: Words like first and last, as well as then and after, can be clues to the order of steps.
